name: Siegfried Grado
original_name: ジークフリード・グラード
source:
The current leader of the Golden Shackles, son of the creator and previous leader, and [url=/c515]Caim's[/url] close friend. The two of them share a long past, having worked as assassins and escaped from countless dangers together. He’s pretty much a huge bro, but he takes his responsibilities as the top figure in the “Prison” very seriously.

[From [url=http://utw.me/2011/05/18/aiyoku-no-eustia-vn-review/#more-3112/]UTW Fansubs' review[/url]]
